magic.task.flight: Afterburn, Magic. You're cleared into the corridor. No tasking, no threats. Fly the gates, stay above the ground, and bring the aeroplane back.
Magic copies you airborne. The sky's yours. Gates are for the score, the crystal is for the scenery. Keep it out of the rocks.
magic.task.war: Afterburn, Magic. Tasking: sweep the corridor. Five groups committed on you. Splash everything airborne, then I'll bring you home. Weapons free.
Magic. Picture: five waves inbound on your corridor, first group twenty miles. Kill them all, then RTB. You are cleared hot.
magic.daily: Afterburn, Magic. Daily run. Same corridor as everyone else today. Your ghost is already airborne. Beat her.
magic.train.open: Afterburn, Magic. First flight. Hook has you from the back seat. Do what he says, one thing at a time, and you'll be fine.
magic.wave.1: Magic, picture. Group one, three bandits, twelve o'clock, twenty miles, low. They'll stay in front of you. Commit.
magic.wave.2: Magic, new picture. Group two, four bandits, twelve o'clock. Watch it: this bunch will drop back onto your six. Commit.
magic.wave.3: Magic. Group three, five bandits on the nose, closing. One of them is hot, head-on. Commit.
magic.wave.4: Magic. Group four, six bandits. Expect them behind you. Use the reversal. Commit.
magic.wave.5: Magic. Group five, seven bandits, everything they have. Clean them up and I'll bring you home.
magic.wave.last: Magic. Last group. Everything they have left is committed on you. Splash them and I'll bring you home.
Magic. Final group inbound. Finish this and you're done for the day.
magic.wave.clear: Magic. Picture clean. Stand by, next group's on the way.
Clean. Take a breath. I'm working the next group.
Magic copies the wave. Picture's clean for now. Stay sharp.
magic.home: Magic. Picture clean, no further tasking. RTB. Weapons safe.
Magic. That's all of them. Come home. Good work.
magic.rtb.base: Magic. Vector home plate, dead ahead, ten miles. Descend at your discretion, gear down inside two miles. You're cleared to land.
Magic. The strip is on your nose, ten miles. Line up early, get the gear down, and ease it on.
magic.rtb.ship: Magic. Mother is dead ahead, ten miles. Call the ball at three quarters of a mile and fly it to the deck. Cleared for the approach.
Magic. Ship's on your nose. Hook down, gear down, fly the ball. Cleared to land.
magic.bingo: Afterburn, Magic. You're bingo fuel. Knock it off and come home now.
magic.missed: Magic. Go around, climb straight ahead. I'll set you up again.
Magic copies the go-around. No harm done. Come back round.
magic.landed: Magic. Welcome home. Good work out there.
Magic copies you down. Nice job, Afterburn.
magic.trap: Magic copies you aboard. Well done.
magic.fail: Afterburn, Magic. That's a scrub. Come home.
Magic. Mission's over. Bring the aeroplane back.
magic.targets.done: Magic. All targets destroyed. Objective complete. Egress and stand by for the CAP.
Magic copies, all targets down. That's the objective. Now get out of there.
magic.two.lost: Magic copies Two is down. No chute. I'm sorry.
Magic. Two's off the scope. Continue if you can.
magic.sam: Magic. SAM site ahead of you. It will shoot first. Get low, or get past it.
Afterburn, Magic. Threat radar ahead, on the ground. Stay in the folds.
magic.weather: Magic. Lost your track in the weather. Call me when you're clear.
Magic has no contact. You're in the cloud. Nobody can see you.
magic.m1: Afterburn, Magic. First light. Three groups are working the valley at low level. Your orders: take Two with you, splash all three groups, keep Two alive, then bring both jets home to the strip. Weapons free.
magic.m2: Afterburn, Magic. Shelf strike. Four SAM sites on the terraces, and they will shoot first. Orders: get under their radar in the folds, put bombs on all four, then fight your way out through the CAP. Home plate is the strip.
magic.m3: Afterburn, Magic. Mother is on the mirror sea with two groups inbound on her. Orders: splash both groups, then recover aboard. Fly the ball. The water is not an option.
magic.m4: Afterburn, Magic. Canyon escort. Two is hurt and has to go through the canyon on the deck. Four groups will try to finish him. Orders: stay on his wing, take the shots he can't, and get him out the far end. He does not go down.
magic.m5: Afterburn, Magic. Graveyard. Three radar domes in the monoliths are cueing the interceptors. Orders: kill the domes, weather the head-on passes, then recover aboard Mother on the sea beyond.
magic.m6: Afterburn, Magic. Midnight. Full moon and a solid deck. Three groups above the tops. Orders: splash them, then a night recovery down through the deck to Mother. Trust the ball, not your eyes.
magic.enter.valley: Magic. You're entering the valley. Forests and gates. Low and slow works here.
magic.enter.shelf: Magic. Entering the shelf. Terraces, and threat radar on them. Stay in the folds.
magic.enter.canyon: Magic. Canyon ahead. Expect wind shear between the walls. Below the rim is worth points, if you keep it off the walls.
magic.enter.sea: Magic. Entering the mirror sea. Flat water, thermals down low. Skim it if you want the bonus.
magic.enter.spires: Magic. Spire forest. Crystal on the corridor. Chain them with the gun if you can, and don't fly into one.
magic.enter.ridge: Magic. The ridge. Lift on the face, sink on the back, and a pass at the top. Cross it low for the bonus.
magic.enter.graveyard: Magic. Entering the graveyard. Monoliths, radar domes, and the interceptor nest. Head-on passes from here.
magic.enter.reach: Magic. The reach. High country and the long intercepts. Watch the islands.

takeoff.flight: Throttle's yours. Let's go scare some scenery.
Alright, hotshot. Wheels up, and try not to hit the only mountain out here.
Runway's clear, sky's clear. Everything else is your problem.
takeoff.war: Cleared hot. They already know we're coming, so let's not disappoint them.
Wheels up, guns hot. Somebody out there wants a fight. Let's give 'em one.
Rolling. Bandits inbound. Coffee's gonna have to wait.
foxtwo: Fox two. That one's got his name on it.
hit.wing: Left wing took one. Roll's gonna feel like wet cardboard.
Wing's hit. She rolls like a bathtub now. Adjust.
hit.engine: Engine's hit. We're down on thrust. Stop wishing, start flying.
Took one in the engine. She's tired. Nurse it.
hit.hyd: Hydraulics. She's heavy on the stick. Muscle it.
Lost hydraulics. Everything's gonna feel like it's underwater.
hit: We're hit! Felt that one in my teeth.
Taking hits! Quit sightseeing and move!
That one hurt. Get us out of his sights.
Hit! Don't fly straight, he'll do it again.
critical: Critical. One more and we're a lawn dart. Get it home.
We're falling apart out here. One more hit and that's the ballgame.
splash.1: That's one. Try not to get cocky.
splash.2: Splash two. Somebody's having a bad day, and it ain't us.
splash.3: Splash three. You're getting good at this.
Three. I'm starting to enjoy myself.
splash.4: Splash four. Okay, now you're showing off.
Four. Leave some for the rest of the squadron.
splash.5: Splash five. I'm running out of jokes.
That's five. You want a medal or a bigger gun?
splash.6: Splash six. I'm gonna need a bigger scoreboard.
Six. Their recruiter's gonna have a busy week.
splash.7: Splash seven. Are you even trying anymore?
Seven. I'll stop counting, you keep shooting.
splash.8: Splash eight. Alright, I'm impressed. Don't let it go to your head.
Eight. Okay, we're done here. Nobody's left.
wave.clear: Picture's clean. Breathe. There's more coming.
Sky's clear. Take five seconds. That's all you get.
That's the wave. Check your six, reload your nerve.
wave.home: Picture's clean. That's the lot. Take us home.
That was all of them. Let's go find something to land on.
Sky's empty. Home, and I'm buying.
rtb.ship: Return to the ship. Line up, call the ball, and don't embarrass me.
Ship's ahead. Fly the ball, catch a wire, and we'll pretend it was smooth.
rtb.base: Return to base. Runway's ahead. Ease it down, hero.
Home plate's dead ahead. Gear down, nose up, no heroics.
sam: SAM launch! Break, flare, and stop admiring it!
Missile off the ground! Flares, now! Beam it!
SAM! Break hard, hit the flares, go!
missile: Missile in the air! Notch it or flare it, but do something!
defeat.flare: Missile went for the flare. Dumb rocket.
Decoyed. That's why we carry those.
defeat.notch: It lost us. That's how you notch a missile.
defeat.cloud: It lost us in the weather. Told you I like clouds.
Missile's blind in this soup. Stay in it a second.
kill.radar: Radar's gone. Nobody's watching us anymore.
kill.sam: Site destroyed. That's how you drop a bomb.
SAM site's a crater. Good bombs.
kill.depot: That depot's gonna burn all week.
targets.done: All targets down. Egress, before somebody starts counting.
That's every target. Let's leave before they get organized.
two.lost: Two's going in. No chute. Damn it.
We lost Two. Get angry later. Fly now.
eclipse: The sun's going out. Not our problem yet.
Eclipse. Don't look at it, look at the ground.
moon.red: That moon's red. I don't love that.
moon: Look at that moon. Now look at the road.
Big moon tonight. Nice night for it.
Full moon over the deck. Enjoy it for one second, then fly.
bingo: Bingo fuel. Head for the deck, unless you enjoy gliding.
We're bingo. Home, now. Gliders don't get paid.
engineout: Engine's out. Congratulations, we're a glider.
Flameout. Okay. Trade height for speed and find something flat.
stall: Stall! Nose down, get the speed back!
She's stalling! Unload, nose down, now!
land.greased: Greased it. I didn't even feel that. Welcome home.
land.down: Wheels down. Welcome home. I've had worse.
We're down. Any landing you walk away from, right?
Welcome home. Nobody tell the maintenance chief.
laser: Laser's online. Point it at something you don't like.
We've got the laser. Go ruin somebody's afternoon.
winchester: Winchester. Guns are empty. Get creative.
We're out of bullets. Missiles or harsh language, your call.
bolter: Bolter, bolter! Power, go around, and stop looking at me.
Missed the wires. Power up, go around, try again.
trap.ok3: Three wire. OK pass. Welcome aboard, ace.
Three wire. That's the one. Nice trap.
trap: Trap. Welcome aboard. A wire's a wire.
We caught one. Not pretty, but we're aboard.
missed: Missed approach. Go around. No shame in it. Some shame.
Go around. Runway's not going anywhere.
gear: Gear! Check your gear, unless you want a belly ride.
Gear's up! Put it down before the runway does it for you!
rim: Below the rim. Nice. Now don't hit it.
Under the rim. Walls on both sides, hands steady.
six: He's on our six! Break now!
Behind us! Break right, break right!
Bandit's on our tail! Don't fly straight!
weather: In the weather. They've lost us. Shh.
We're in the clouds. Nobody can see us. Don't ruin it.
mission.fail: Mission failed. We'll talk about it on the ground.
That's a scrub. Debrief's gonna be a long one.
enter.valley: Entering the valley. The trees don't move. You do.
Valley. Forests, gates, and a whole lot of nothing to hit but the ground.
enter.shelf: Entering the shelf. Watch the terraces, they bite.
The shelf. Terraces and SAM sites. Stay in the folds.
enter.canyon: Entering the canyon. Walls on both sides and wind in between.
Canyon. The wind's gonna shove us around in here. Fly it, don't fight it.
enter.sea: Entering the mirror sea. Don't stare at your reflection.
The sea. Flat, wide, and shiny. Skim it if you're feeling brave.
enter.spires: Entering the spire forest. Crystal everywhere. Try not to become a windshield.
Spires. Big, pretty, and they don't move. Don't test that.
enter.ridge: Entering the ridge. There's a pass up ahead. Take it low if you're brave.
The ridge. Lift on the face, sink on the back. Mind the pass.
enter.graveyard: Entering the graveyard. Monoliths, domes, and things that don't like us.
Graveyard. If it's tall and dark, it's a rock. If it's shooting, it's not.
enter.reach: Entering the reach. Long way down from here.
The reach. High country. Watch the islands, they hang around.
train.0: Throttle up. Rotate when she's ready. She'll tell you. Once we're up, the mouse is the stick: middle is level, push it where you want to go.
train.1: Pull up. Climb through six hundred. Sky's that way.
train.2: Now turn. Push the stick out to the side and lean into it.
train.3: Light the burner. Hold space and enjoy the push.
train.4: Roll it. Q or E. Don't overthink it.
train.5: Airbrake. Hold shift and feel it bite.
train.6: Thread a gate. Through the ring, not into it.
train.7: Good. Now bring it home. Line up on the runway, ease it down, and flare.
m1: First light. Three waves in the valley. Keep Two alive, then land it.
m2: Shelf strike. Four SAM sites on the terraces. Get low, bomb 'em, get out.
m3: Mirror. Two waves are coming for the carrier. Splash 'em, then trap aboard.
m4: Canyon escort. Two's hurt. Stay on his wing through the canyon, no matter what.
m5: Graveyard. Three radar domes in the monoliths. Kill 'em, then find the ship.
m6: Midnight. Three waves above the deck, then a night trap. Trust the ball.
copy: Copy, Magic. You heard the lady.
Copy all. Let's go earn it.
Roger, Magic. Wasn't gonna do anything else anyway.
Copy. Hook's got the back seat, you've got the stick. Don't mix 'em up.
commit: Got 'em on the scope. Let's go say hi.
Contact. Burner if you want 'em close, brake if you want 'em gone.
radiocheck: Loud and clear, Magic. Bored, but clear.
Five by five. Miss us already?
Read you, Magic. Still airborne, still handsome.
rtb.copy: Copy home plate. Get us on the ground in one piece.
Roger, heading home. Nose up, gear down, no heroics.
Copy. Land it like you mean it.
merge: He's turning in behind us! Merge! Watch your six!
Passed us and he's coming round. He'll be on our tail in a second.
Merge! He's swinging onto our six. Don't fly straight.
overshoot: He overshot! He's in front of us, take the shot!
There he goes, right past us. Gun him, gun him!
Overshoot! He's on the nose. Don't waste it.
cobra: Cobra! Hang on and watch him go by!
Nose up, everything stops. Here he comes past.
splits: Inverted and pulling. Ground's coming up, so pull.
immelmann: Over the top. World's turning round. There he is, on the nose.
Immelmann. What was behind us is in front now. Shoot it.
streak: Five gates straight. You're showing off and I'm here for it.
That's a streak. Don't blink now.
Five in a row. Somebody's been practicing.
knife: Knife edge through the ring. Fancy.
Sideways through a gate. Somebody's feeling good.
nearmiss: That was close! Quit it. Actually, don't.
Missed it by a coat of paint. Again!
treetop: Treetops. Lower. No, wait, that's low enough.
In the trees. I can smell the pine from here.
arch: Under the arch! Nobody saw that but me.
Through the arch. I'd clap if I wasn't holding on.

two.hit.crit: Two's hit! I'm in trouble here!
Two's hurt bad! I can't take another one!
two.hit: Took one. I'm okay. Keep going.
two.tally: Two's got eyes on. Bandit, dead ahead.
two.wing: Still here. Still bored. Find me something to shoot.
two.rtb: Two's with you. Take us home.
Two copies home plate. Right behind you, lead.
